content: In the Prologue Melvin-Koushki says the calligraphy and Persian verse of the Shaykh Luṭf Allāh Mosque state explicitly that Hearing is ontologically superior and therefore epistemologically inferior to Sight; he describes the mosque as the most literal architectural incarnation of the Planet-Pearl-Peach series, despite and because of a riddling reversion to Pearl-Peach-Planet.
